title: Yamatagi-Madara of the Accursed Land
overview: On a secluded mountain, a mysterious entity exists that the locals are warned to go nowhere near...

title: Visiting the School for the First Time
overview: Dara-san, curious about Kaoru and Hinata's lives, decides to stealthily slither around to see what's going on.

title: The Laws of Forbidden Ground
overview: Dara-san's wardrobe expands as she teaches Kaoru and Hinata about treading into supernatural territory.

title: The Return of Yamatagi-Madara
overview: An unexpected new student arrives in Hinata's class.

title: Genealogy of Mountain Stewards
overview: Hinata has a birthday, and her mom, Chiyo, reminiscences about her encounters with the mountain's guardian.

title: The Phantom Water God
overview: Hinata and Kaoru head out of town where they have an encounter with a different supernatural entity.

title: A Picture Show of Bygone Days
overview: Dara-san wonders about the circumstances on the mountain after she lost her mind as a cursed spirit.

title: A Serpent's Struggles
overview: Yamatagi-Madara plots his revenge on Dara-san with questionable results.

title: Seven Wonders of the School
overview: Hinata is staying late at her middle school to prep for the culture festival.

title: A Culture Festival for Two
overview: While Hinata works her school's culture festival, Kaoru sets up a private cafe for Dara-san.

title: The Taboo Test of Courage
overview: Hinata's classmates venture up the mountain.
